competitors.title: Archon: The First Open-Source Harness Builder for AI Coding — PyShine (April 11, 2026)
key_points: Detailed architecture: 4-layer design (Platform Adapters → Orchestrator → Engine Components → Database)
Platform adapters: Web UI (SSE), CLI, Telegram (Bot API), Slack (SDK), Discord (WebSocket), GitHub (webhooks)
3 core engines: Command Handler (deterministic), Workflow Executor (YAML DAG), AI Assistant Clients
8 database tables: codebases, conversations, sessions, isolation_environments, workflow_runs, events, messages, env_vars
6 workflow node types: Prompt, Bash, Command, Script, Loop, Approval (human gates)
Full setup takes ~5 minutes (clone → bun install → claude)
Workflow execution flow: User Request → Plan → Implement Loop → Validate → Review → Approval Gate → PR
Monorepo with Bun workspaces: foundation packages, application packages, adapter packages
